query:
UPDATE agents
             SET name = $1, description = $2, system_prompt_extensions = $3,
                 model_preference = $4, verification_command = $5,
                 mcp_servers = $6, skills = $7, learned_prompt = $8,
                 updated_at = to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
             WHERE id = $9
